summary: The subset defines strong fail-closed scanner, artifact, execution, and verification boundaries, with consistent Playwright/Cypress scope. Three bounded contract defects remain: inconsistent suppression documentation, an overbroad Locator.count prohibition, and an unsanitized Cypress error-output path.

findings.title: Suppression phase contract contradicts scanner behavior
findings.evidence: This line says position 2 enclosing callback/block suppression remains Phase 2-only, but the included scanner mechanically treats a JUSTIFIED marker above brace-delimited evaluate/waitForFunction callbacks as suppression. Users therefore cannot determine whether those P1/P2 candidates reach semantic review.
findings.recommendation: Document the bounded evaluate/waitForFunction exception on this line, or remove its mechanical suppression and defer all position 2 cases to Phase 2.

findings.title: Blanket count prohibition exceeds reviewer semantics
findings.evidence: The generation table forbids every `const n = await el.count()` and proposes a fixed-count assertion or first-element visibility, although Locator.count() can legitimately supply iteration or branching data and the reviewer contract flags only non-retrying or insufficient assertions. The suggested alternatives are not behaviorally equivalent when the expected count is dynamic.
findings.recommendation: Restrict the prohibition to count values used as one-shot outcome assertions; permit count reads for evidenced control/data use and require a separate web-first primary postcondition.

findings.title: Cypress output contract lacks sanitized-error provenance
findings.evidence: The finding template directs emission of an error excerpt, while the skill accepts directly supplied errors and stacks and treats artifact text as untrusted. Unlike the Playwright debugger contract, it does not require this field to come from bounded redacted reader output or define a safe fallback.
findings.recommendation: Require a quoted, bounded, redacted error excerpt from the bundled reader; for directly supplied text, apply the same redaction and length limits or emit an unavailable placeholder.

limitations: Packet-only static review; no commands, tests, benchmarks, holdouts, or runtime probes were used.
Referenced but omitted files—including applying-fixes.md, scanner auxiliary parsers/rules, CI test implementations, and agent manifests—could not be assessed.
This subset review is not full product coverage, skill accuracy, independent ground truth, human or sealed review, or remote model attestation.
